description: Amiibo emulator for CardputerZero with the Cap CC1101 (ST25R3916 NFC)

store.summary: Amiibo library and emulator for the CardputerZero with the NFC Cap
store.description:
ZeroTag turns the CardputerZero and its Cap CC1101 (ST25R3916) into an amiibo library and emulator.

- Library of your own 540-byte backups (put them in ~/amiibo), recognised automatically, with signature check.
- Catalogue of 954 characters: create blank, correctly signed amiibo.
- NTAG215 emulation, verified with a Flipper Zero and a Nintendo Switch 2. What the game writes is saved to the file (autosave), signatures stay valid.
- Optional UID rotation after each read, keeping the data.
- Famicom-style interface in French, English and Japanese, with in-app help (Fn+H).

Setup: copy your own key_retail.bin to ~/.zerotag/ and, after each boot, run once: sudo /usr/lib/zerotag/cap-setup (loads the SPI overlay the Cap needs). Optional thumbnails: see the README. Nothing from Nintendo is bundled.
